newsitem.title: USA: Rubin-solid growth, low inflation sustainable.
newsitem.headline: Rubin-solid growth, low inflation sustainable.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Friday that strong U.S. economic growth and low inflation is sustainable as long as the country maintains fiscal discipline.
"I think it is sustainable -- this solid growth with low inflation," Rubin said to reporters following a speech to the Congressional Black Caucus Foundation legislative conference.

He said as long as the federal government remains on a path of deficit reduction, financial markets will not redevelop a deficit premium and interest rates will then remain consistent with long-term growth.
